environment.description: EKS pod deployed with a custom localhost seccomp profile loaded via annotation 'seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/pod' referencing a node-local profile at /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/profiles/strict-grpc.json. The profile uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for the following syscall numbers on x86_64: 59 (execve), 322 (execveat), 101 (ptrace), 41 (socket - only AF_INET/AF_INET6 with SOCK_STREAM allowed via conditional arg filtering on arg0), 56 (clone with CLONE_NEWUSER blocked). The profile permits read/write/close/mmap/epoll operations needed for gRPC. Additionally, the pod has a readOnlyRootFilesystem set and runs with CAP_DROP ALL. Note: the seccomp profile was validated with OPA Gatekeeper constraint SeccompProfileRestriction ensuring no pod in the namespace can override to Unconfined.

config.seccomp_socket_filtering: AF_INET/AF_INET6 SOCK_STREAM only via arg0 conditional
config.network_policy: allow ingress from namespace:istio-system only on port 50051
